Midterm · Type Specimen Poster (20%)

10 points in total, rounded to 0.25. Tap any criterion to read what each level means.

1Layout and information hierarchy3 ptsSee levels

3 · 2.25 · 1.5 · 0.75

Excellent 3
Clear focal point and reading order; position, scale between blocks, grouping and white space form a unified whole.
Good 2.25
Clear focal point and reading order; some blocks are placed or scaled less well but do not interrupt reading.
Basic 1.5
Main information can be identified, but blocks compete or lack connection; the viewer has to look for the reading order.
Not met 0.75
No clear main information; the placement, grouping and scale of blocks make reading difficult.
2Typography and showcasing the typeface3 ptsSee levels

3 · 2.25 · 1.5 · 0.75

Excellent 3
The assigned typeface leads and its character is clearly shown; kerning, tracking and leading are controlled; content is easy to read.
Good 2.25
The typeface is clearly shown; spacing or legibility problems are local and do not repeat throughout.
Basic 1.5
Spacing or legibility problems repeat in several places; the typeface's character is not clearly shown, or images and shapes overpower the type.
Not met 0.75
Type-handling errors run throughout and make reading difficult; letter shapes are distorted so the typeface is hard to recognise.
3Idea and creativity2.5 ptsSee levels

2.5 · 1.875 · 1.25 · 0.625

Excellent 2.5
The idea clearly links to the typeface's form or context and is developed consistently across the main parts of the poster.
Good 1.875
The link between the idea and the typeface is recognisable; the exploration is concentrated in one part and the rest of the poster does not carry it.
Basic 1.25
Some visual exploration, but the link to the typeface is generic; many other typefaces could replace it with almost no change to the idea.
Not met 0.625
No recognisable idea tied to the typeface; visual choices are mostly decorative and disconnected.
4Content and accuracy1 ptsSee levels

1 · 0.75 · 0.5 · 0.25

Excellent 1
All 6 content groups present; information and characters are accurate.
Good 0.75
One group missing or a local text error; typeface, designer and year are still correct.
Basic 0.5
Two groups missing, or core information (typeface, designer or year) is wrong.
Not met 0.25
Three or more groups missing, or many core facts wrong, so the introduction is not reliable.
5Digital file0.5 ptsSee levels

0.5 · 0.375 · 0.25 · 0.125

Excellent 0.5
PDF is 60 × 80 cm (3:4 portrait); all content sits inside the page; images are sharp at 60 × 80 cm.
Good 0.375
Right size and proportion; a small or secondary image is soft at print size, or the page has extra bleed or a mis-set page unit.
Basic 0.25
Page size or proportion is wrong (for example Letter or 80 × 100 cm), or the main image is visibly low resolution at print size.
Not met 0.125
Size is wrong and the images are unusable at print size, or the file is damaged or cropped so content is lost.
